name: I'm Just Here to Change the Lights
source:
Changing some lights in an apartment? This should be a breeze! You're a gig worker on TaskHare who's accepted a last minute job on Halloween morning. Unbeknownst to you, the three roommates you're helping out are not what they appear (not to mention whatever their costumes are).

[From [url=https://cygni.itch.io/change-the-lights]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
去一间公寓里换几个灯泡？这活儿应该轻而易举！你是零工平台“野兔跑腿”上的一名兼职接单员，在万圣节清晨临时接下了一单急活。然而你浑然不知的是，你要帮忙的那三位合租室友绝非表面看上去那样简单（更别提他们身上穿的那些奇装异服到底是怎么回事了）。

[摘自[url=https://cygni.itch.io/change-the-lights]itch.io[/url]]
